meta.goal: Design a battery for extreme-cold environment equipment: 1C discharge capacity retention >= 95% at -20C, energy density >= 327.18 Wh/kg, volumetric energy density >= 880 Wh/L
meta.base_basis: task text specifies no electrode system -> anchor-table default Chen2020 (NMC811/graphite), recorded per protocol
meta.retention_definition: lowT_discharge (253.15 K, 1C) capacity / 1C_discharge (298.15 K) capacity, same params, mechanically computed
meta.safety_criteria_source: protocol-standard defaults; task text specifies no safety metrics (4C_charge_45C exam: plated=false, T_max<=60C; overcharge: triggered=false)

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (widest interpretation; base Chen2020 default, switch only on evidence)
freedoms.electrolyte_formulation: adjustable (Electrolyte conductivity/diffusivity, Cation transference number; primary lever for low-T)
freedoms.electrode_modification: adjustable (SEI kinetic rate constant / SEI reaction exchange current density / cracking rate)
freedoms.cell_architecture: adjustable (thickness/porosity/N-P/separator thickness & porosity/current collector thickness/particle radius)
freedoms.thermal_management: adjustable (Total heat transfer coefficient; both directions: cooling-up for 4C exam, insulation-down for cold retention)
